params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Corki's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description2: {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts and all {{tip|Spellblade}} effects are special cased to benefit from ''Hextech Munitions'', causing them to deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to 20% of their {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.
params.notes:
* The mixed damage is dealt in two simultaneous instances of damage, but will pretend to be a single instance for most effects (such as {{ris|Conqueror}} stacking).
** The {{as|true damage}} is dealt in an instance before the {{as|physical damage}}.
** Both instances deal {{tip|basic damage}} and thus natively apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
** The attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, right at the start.
** Even if the target dies from the {{as|true damage}}, the {{as|physical damage}} will still be applied to it.
*** If the target dies from {{tip|on-hit}} damage, the true damage portion will be skipped and only the physical damage applied.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Innate: Corki basic attacks deal bonus true damage.

description.plain: Innate: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage equal to 20% AD. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description2.plain: ⟦iis⟧ Wind's Fury bolts and all Spellblade effects are special cased to benefit from Hextech Munitions, causing them to deal bonus true damage equal to 20% of their pre-mitigation damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Corki}} fires a flash bomb at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|sight|revealing}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' launches a bomb at the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels and explodes upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: The bomb also grants {{tip|sight}} of the impact area for 6 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy {{tip|champions}} hit for the same duration.
params.notes: * The missile has a minimum travel time of {{fd|0.227}} seconds.

blurb.plain: Active: Corki fires a flash bomb at the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and revealing enemy champions hit.

description.plain: Active: Corki launches a bomb at the target location that briefly grants sight of its surroundings as it travels and explodes upon impact, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.plain: The bomb also grants sight of the impact area for 6 seconds and reveals enemy champions hit for the same duration.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Corki}} {{tip|dash|flies}} a short distance to the target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that deals {{as|magic damage}} continually to enemies within.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and drops bombs that leave up to 3 blazing patches along his path, depending on the distance traveled. Each patch lasts {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.description2: Enemies within the patches are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lingering for 1 second.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*5 to 90*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''{{ai|Gatling Gun|Corki}} can be cast during the dash.''

blurb.plain: Active: Corki flies a short distance to the target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that deals magic damage continually to enemies within.

description.plain: Active: Corki dashes to the target location and drops bombs that leave up to 3 blazing patches along his path, depending on the distance traveled. Each patch lasts 2.5 seconds.

description2.plain: Enemies within the patches are dealt magic damage every 0.5 seconds, lingering for 1 second.

description3.plain: Gatling Gun can be cast during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Corki}} gatling gun rapidly fires in a {{tt|frontal|In his facing direction}} cone, continually dealing {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|stacks}} of ''Gatling Gun'' to enemies hit.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Gatling Gun:}} For each stack, the target loses {{as|{{sti|lethality|armor}}}} and {{as|{{sti|magic penetration|magic resist}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' sprays bullets in a cone toward his facing direction for 4 seconds, dealing {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to all enemies hit and applying a {{tip|stack}} to them at the same tick rate for 2 seconds, refreshing with subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|lethality|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Tick|{{ap|80/16 to 280/16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|240/16}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}} {{as|(+ 240% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Resistances Reduction Per Stack|{{ap|3 to 5}}|Total Resistances Reduction|{{ap|3*4 to 5*4}}}}
params.notes:
* The maximum resistances reduction is applied after 4 ticks (1 second).
* The direction of the gun firing changes depending on where '''Corki''' is facing.
** '''Corki''' will turn to face in the direction of the cursor upon casting ''Gatling Gun''. He will also instantly turn when issuing an Attack order on enemies while ''Gatling Gun'' is active.
** Issuing an Attack Move order at a location will not cause '''Corki''' to instantly turn.{{bug|2}}
* ''Gatling Gun's'' area of effect can hit close by enemies next to and behind him, due to registering {{tip|er|enemies' edge}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Corki gatling gun rapidly fires in a frontal cone, continually dealing physical damage and applying stacks of Gatling Gun to enemies hit.

blurb4.plain: Gatling Gun: For each stack, the target loses armor and magic resist.

description.plain: Active: Corki sprays bullets in a cone toward his facing direction for 4 seconds, dealing physical damage every 0.25 seconds to all enemies hit and applying a stack to them at the same tick rate for 2 seconds, refreshing with subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Each stack reduces the target's armor and magic resistance.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Corki}} fires a missile in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies in an area.
params.blurb2: '''Corki''' stores missiles over time, and starts with maximum missiles when he respawns.
params.blurb3: Every 3rd missile fired is a ''Big One'': which fires farther and deals increased damage in a bigger explosion.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against champions reduce ''Missile Barrage's'' remaining recharge time by {{pp|2 to 6 for 11|0 to 100|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|key1=%}} seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within the area.
params.description3: '''Corki''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Missile Barrage'' charge, up to a maximum of 4. He gains 2 charges upon learning the ability and maximum charges upon [[death|respawning]].
params.description4: Every third missile '''Corki''' fires is a ''{{ai|Big One|Corki}}'', dealing 100% increased damage as well as gaining increased range and explosion radius.
params.target range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1300|Standard missile range}}|{{tt|1500|Big One missile range}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|150|Standard explosion radius}}|{{tt|300|Big One explosion radius}}}}
params.speed: {{tt|2000|Missile speed for both standard and Big One missiles}}
params.width: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|80|Both standard and Big One missile width}}
params.notes:
* Once '''Corki''' has learned the ability:
** He receives a {{tip|buff}} that counts a cycle of the number of times ''Missile Barrage'' has been used since the last ''Big One''.
** An indicator becomes visible below his [[health bar]] that tracks the number of missiles in reserve and whether a ''Big One'' is available. They are spent from {{tt|left to right|default, for left-to-right locales}}.
* '''Corki''' retains progress towards a ''Big One'' when he {{tip|fatal damage|dies}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* ''Missile Barrage's'' effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.
* {{iis|Malignance}} damage from ''Missile Barrage'' does not count toward {{iis|Eclipse}} passive.
